reasons: Independent SS/PS arc resampling was incorrectly used to define the mean line.
Independent half-thickness fields allowed mean-line drift.
Secondary surface splines did not strictly satisfy the normal-offset contract.
Nearest-vertex distances introduced a sample-spacing floor in contour metrics.
preservation: Old manifest, Parquet and raw NASA coordinates are retained without overwriting.
comparison_warning: Old and new reported RMS use different distance estimators; no direct improvement ratio.
